name: Force the stock vLLM Triton W4A16 backend for every GPTQ projection
hypothesis: The already-shipped Triton W4A16 backend may outperform Marlin for SM89 M=1 projection shapes even though it is lower in vLLM's generic priority list.
expected_global_effect: Replace all 96 decode Marlin projections while preserving the frozen GPTQ tensors and BF16 activation contract; screen end-to-end so repacking, graph capture and epilogues remain visible.

preserved_dependencies: each projection consumes the same BF16 activation after all preceding layer dependencies
each projection produces the same logical output shape before its unchanged consumer
all recurrent and KV state transitions remain in stock vLLM
changed_boundaries: GPTQ qweight is losslessly repacked from K-packed checkpoint order to the Triton backend's N-packed order at load time
Marlin tensor-core implementation is replaced by Triton unpack-dequantize-dot for supported linear layers
prohibited_rewrites: no modification of GPTQ integer values or scales
no output-head shortlist, speculative decode or skipped work
dependency_contract.numerical_ordering: The alternative kernel may change floating-point accumulation order, so promotion requires exact greedy token identity on every frozen case; broader qualification remains mandatory.

evidence.claim: The checkpoint-derived six shapes sum to exactly the 96 observed Marlin calls per decode.
